Commercial aggregator with extra non-Kbt. buyer coverage but requires subscription/registration to use.
Second commercial alert vendor largely redundant with c_015; paid access needed for real value.
Vendor cluster useful only as coverage benchmark and keyword taxonomy; redundant with official sources.

One-off EKR manual PDF; keep as engineering reference for collector design, not monitored.

Authority statistics and annual reports size and trend banking/payments procurement volumes.

Official EU gazette carrying all above-threshold HU banking/payments notices in machine-readable form.

TED bulk XML archives enable multi-year backfill of incumbency, values and renewal cycles.
